messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating canary rollout v2026-03-21.2 -> prod. target buckets: 15% us-east.

alex: quick check 1: looking at rerank-service SLOs: p95 up from 85ms -> 420ms, 429s rising from 0.03% -> 0.9% in last 4m. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/slo?svc=rerank&deploy=v2026-03-21.2

rachel: traces show upstream backpressure: rerank queue depth spiking, worker concurrency hitting limit. sample trace id https://traces.redwood/trace/ef56a7

tom: Could be due to the new quantized model variant dropping request batching efficiency. Also seeing high gRPC RST_STREAM counts.

alex: recommend temporary mitigation: enable circuit-breaker on rerank route and reduce concurrent requests per-worker to 8. If that stabilizes, we can continue ramp; otherwise pin rerank to model:quant-v1-2026-03-10.

qa-bot: Suggested command snippets:

```
# apply circuit breaker rule
redwood route update /rerank --circuit-breaker=true --error-threshold=0.5 --window=60s
# patch deployment concurrency
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/rerank-workers WORKER_CONCURRENCY=8
```

ops-notify-bot: Creating incident INC-2026-084: rerank-canary-backpressure; paging SRE on-call. Labels: deploy-canary, high-latency.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp paused by request from @eng-releases at 1742605660 1 reason: rerank 429/latency spike.

alex: applied circuit-breaker + lowered concurrency. warming nodes, watching SLOs.

alex: 3m after changes: p95 falling to 130ms, 429s down to 0.12%, queue depth normalized.

rachel: traces post-change show no gRPC resets and steady response codes. Looks like batching mismatch caused worker queuing under new quantized path.

tom: follow-up action: add a canary-only flag to disable model vectorized-batch mode until batching heuristics are updated (ENG-4922). Patch I will open now.

alex: decision: keep canary paused and hold on additional ramp. Pin decision: no full rollback; route-level circuit-breaker + concurrency limit will stay for canary for 30m. If metrics remain stable for 30m, proceed with gradual ramp. If 429 > 0.5% -> rollback.

ops-notify-bot: Reminder set: re-evaluate at 1742607355 (30m).

rachel: release notes blurb: "Canary paused mid-ramp: rerank route has temporary circuit-breaker and lowered concurrency due to transient backpressure with quantized model variant. Investigating batching heuristics; follow-up ticket ENG-4922."

alex: adding runbook step for future: verify worker concurrency + batch latency in preflight for quantized variants.

qa-bot: Added canary smoke test to run after changes: `make smoke-canary TEST=rerank`

alex: thanks all. I'll keep monitoring and update the thread. :thumbsup:
